name: scrapedia__scrapy-httpcache
behavioral_change: Scrapy v_old 2.3.0 to v_new 2.13.3 (resolved value). The request fingerprint function (scrapy.utils.request.request_fingerprint, replaced by fingerprint) returns bytes instead of a hexadecimal string; the case is mixed with the function rename, and the sources note that the break first surfaces as an ImportError.
downstream_effect: The downstream cache code that expects a hexadecimal string fingerprint fails after the upgrade; the human test_patch only adds a reactor import line and is only indirectly related to the break.
reference_fix: The reference fix adapts the downstream code to the bytes fingerprint and the renamed function.

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
